thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty autopage fired -> INC-78912 for host 'phi-gpu-23' (region: us-west-2). Symptoms: kernel panic observed, kubelet NotReady. Auto-fanout to eng-oncall. pd:pd-78912.

pagerduty: New incident INC-78912 created by alert rule 'node-kernel-oops' (severity: P1). Escalation policy: oncall -> 2nd. Pager will auto-escalate in 5m if unacked.

sara: acked. I'm taking first response. I'll try serial console attach then check kubelet logs.

matt: pinging BMC/console now, also checking recent deploys. Any customer-facing alerts?

priya: pulling metrics: model-serving errors spike on host phi-gpu-23's AZ. Quick numbers: 12 pods on node, ~180r/s total that touched that node, ~3k requests failed over last 60s but most retried. Tentative customer impact: 1 active customer job saw latency spikes and ~4 dropped requests. Will confirm SLA impact.

kevin: runbook step 1: serial attach -> capture dmesg -> confirm kernel oops. If console unresponsive, cordon+drain. I can prepare cordon/drain commands:
```
kubectl cordon phi-gpu-23
kubectl drain phi-gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30
```
Also have the BMC command ready: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-phi-23 -U admin -P **** sol activate`

matt: serial attached, output below (truncated):
```
[  123.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[  123.456790] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted
[  123.456791] Call Trace:
[  123.456792]  dump_stack+0x5c/0x7b
[  123.456793]  panic+0x1c3/0x324
[  123.456794]  do_exit+0x7a/0x2d0
[  123.456795]  ?? __kmalloc
[  123.456796] ---[ end trace 0a0b1c2d3e ]---
```
Console stops updating, BMC SOL looks alive but kernel is hung.

incident-bot: Autopage note: system observed repeated panic events -> auto-suppression turned on for 10m to prevent pager storms.

sara: node looks unhealthy, kubelet NotReady and won't recover. I'll cordon+drain to force failover for pods. Priya, do we want to trigger routing fallback for the model pool?

priya: Yes — triggering policy to route new requests away from that AZ and enabling extra burst capacity in dedicated pool. Notifying SRE and product support. I'll post a short customer-facing note if impact crosses 5% error rate. Right now it's under that.

kevin: proceeding with drain now. Running drain commands. If any pod stuck on eviction, we'll force delete and mark for reprovision later.

sara: drain output: some stateful pods took longer; forced eviction applied. PV detach in progress.

matt: filing quick hardware check: NVMe SMART shows reallocated sectors rising. Suspect NVMe failure triggered kernel oops. Opening hardware follow-up INF-2026-12345. RMA likely.

oncall-2nd: I'm joining the thread to take handoff at 1779992500. Summary for handoff: phi-gpu-23 kernel panic + kubelet NotReady -> serial shows oops -> node cordoned and drained by sara/kevin -> routing fallback in place, Priya managing customer comms. Actions remaining: schedule RMA, verify reroute steady-state, monitor for replica rebuilds, & follow up on PV detach. Assign RMA to kevin.

kevin: RMA ticket created with datacenter team, tracking #RMA-4567. ETA for tech arrival: 6 hours. I'll keep the node cordoned until replaced.

priya: Customer impact update: We saw a short spike in 5xxs between 1779992240-1779992300 (about 120s). Approximately 4 requests failed and were dropped despite retries; some retries succeeded afterwards. No bulk customer outages. I'll notify support to reach out to affected customer (ID: cust-83421) proactively.

sara: quick post-action notes:
- Node cordoned/drained at 1779992360.
- PVs detached and PVCs rebound to other nodes by 1779992460.
- Autoscaler spun up 2 replacement pods in alternate pool.
- Observed latency normalized by 1779992520.

matt: follow-ups: collect full dmesg + crash dump, upload to artifact bucket: s3://redwood-dumps/INC-78912/phi-gpu-23-dump-1779992222.tar.gz. Add to incident ticket.

oncall-2nd: handoff closed to night rotation. If we see repeated kernel oops across rack, we'll escalate to infra-team for urgent hardware sweep. For now, monitor and confirm RMA and replacement.

incident-bot: Incident INC-78912 acknowledged and resolved for on-call; status: mitigated. Next step: postmortem assigned to matt + sara, P0 blameless postmortem due in 72h.

kevin: logging follow-up checklist in ticket INF-2026-12345: SMART logs, kernel panic trace, BIOS/fw versions, current kernel modules loaded, nvme serial.

priya: customer comms sent to support. No immediate SLA breach. Closing public incident note as 'mitigated - node hardware failure - RMA scheduled'.

sara: marking thread: resolved -> we will reopen if further panics seen. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
